headline: China’s agriculture ministry opens a key-lab selection round for agricultural AI and biomanufacturing
summary: China’s Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs published a call on 6 November 2026, signed by its Science and Technology Department on 5 November, to add key laboratories in agricultural AI and biomanufacturing. The notice gives applicant, staffing and facility criteria and sets a 30 November submission deadline. The linked directions and application forms were not readable in this review. This is evidence of a ministry selection process, not of awarded funding, selected laboratories, operating labs or research outcomes.
